caseNameFull: American Snuff Co. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. L. A. Luce for petitioner. Solicitor General Jackson, Assistant Attorney General Morris, and Messrs. Sewall Key and L. W. Post for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Stone took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
